reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001326 (the melody read from 001326a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells Joseph Perry Holbrook as “Joseph Parry Holbrook”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. Joseph Perry Holbrook's dates (1822–1888) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/miriam_holbrook (MIRIAM, Joseph P. Holbrook, 1865); https://hymnary.org/person/Holbrook_JP (Holbrook, Joseph P. (Joseph Perry), 1822-1888); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2008182910 (Holbrook, Joseph P. (Joseph Perry), 1822-1888). CCEH writes his middle name Parry; CCEH's page gives only the year 1865. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001326a.nwc).
